picks.showTitle: Zen Stories & Buddhist Teachings for Sleep by Midnight Monk
picks.title: Zen Stories for Letting Go - Fall Asleep to Buddhist Teachings for Deep Peace and Acceptance
picks.summary: Tonight we explore acceptance, one of the quietest and most freeing teachings in Zen and Buddhism. So much of our tension comes from wishing things were different: the day, the people around us, even ourselves. The Buddha saw this clearly, and he offered a gentler way to live, one that begins with making peace with what is already here.This is a 3-hour audio for sleep and relaxation, filled with Zen stories, Buddhist teachings, and calm reflections on acceptance and letting go. Along the way we touch on impermanence, self-compassion, difficult emotions, mindfulness, and the freedom of releasin
picks.reason: Zen stories and teachings on acceptance and letting go for peaceful sleep.

These teachings on non-attachment, impermanence, and presence offer wisdom for seekers longing for genuine tranquilit

picks.showTitle: Buddhism for Sleep & Zen Stories by Sleepy Monk
picks.title: Dissolve Into Silence - Fall Asleep to Buddha's Wisdom and Zen Stories to Quiet the Mind
picks.summary: Tonight, we sit with teachings that dissolve the noise of the busy mind. These Zen stories and Buddhist reflections reveal how we construct a narrow sense of self, and how peace floods back when we remember the stillness that was never lost. The fire hums quietly as gentle music holds you. No effort is asked of you now. No figuring out, no becoming better. Just sink into these ancient teachings and let sleep find you naturally. We are grateful you chose to spend this time with us. Feel free to follow this sleep podcast for more calming Zen Buddhism and gentle stories to fall asleep. Thank you
picks.reason: Zen stories and reflections on self and stillness to quiet the mind for sleep.
